text_block_list.text: (Vrooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid. Right on schedule. Shall we 
board, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Heading into the Japan Cup, I 
have steadily built up my strength.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We'll do the rest of the review on the 
bus—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait for me, bus~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san...!? Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You were supposed to be on the bus that 
left 15 minutes ago. We went over the 
itinerary together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ehe☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. You held an impromptu live show 
for the locals and missed your ride as a 
result... is that right?”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I only meant for it to be a little 
thing, you know? Just one farewell song 
for the people at the training camp...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I ended up getting way too excited! 
...You're exasperated, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm dumbfounded.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Bummer... ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is solely regarding the failure 
to give prior notice.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
When you decided to hold a concert, you 
should have given a heads-up to your 
teachers and others. Because...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san's concerts are always so hype. 
There's no way it's ending after just one 
song.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Flash-san☆☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The bus is about to depart. Please sit 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's tight, Falcon-san. Please scoot five 
centimeters to the right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my☆ I'm gonna snuggle 5 centimeters 
closer♪

And so, with barely any time to reflect, 
the lively summer training camp came to a 
close...
